issue.title: Intentions, summary, and reflection on every day and period, shown in an intention card
issue.description: Every canonical daily note and every week, quarter, and year note carries the same three hidden frontmatter fields: `intentions` (Bryan's list), `summary` (an agent's short account of what happened), and `reflection` (Bryan's account of what it meant). bob is the only writer. A new intention card in the property-card family (album, record, and bank cards) shows the fields at the top of the note, and `==` edits them. The daily Headline, week Intentions, quarter Outcomes, and year Theme are migrated and retired. The morning ritual gains a PRE row that launches a summary agent and a POST row that reflects on yesterday. The agent finds the summary instructions through bob, never through note text.

payload.entry:
COPY CHIP FOR THE GTD ROW (Bryan's request, 2026-11-19). When phase adopt (bob-cli-nh.8) adds the `#pre #periods` **Summarize yesterday** row to ~/bob/gtd_daily.md, put its agent prompt in a copy chip instead of double quotes. A copy chip is an inline code span with a `copy[label]:` prefix. The prompt contains backticks, so the span uses a double-backtick run. Write the row's prompt clause exactly like this; the rest of the row stays as planned:

launch an agent with ``copy[summary prompt]: Summarize yesterday's daily note (`bob periods brief yesterday` prints the instructions and evidence)`` · done once the agent runs, or when yesterday's summary is already drafted or edited.

Rules:
- The chip payload (after `copy[summary prompt]: `) must be byte-identical to the plan's prompt. Drop the surrounding double quotes.
- When rewording the Weekly, Quarterly, and Yearly review rows or the weekly PRE row, keep any existing ``copy[...]: ...`` chips intact and edit only around them. A separate epic converts the existing last-week, last-quarter, and last-year prompts into chips with the labels `last-week prompt`, `last-quarter prompt`, and `last-year prompt`.
- Write the chip even if the bob-copy-chips Obsidian plugin has not deployed yet. Until then the span reads as inline code, so do not wait for the plugin.
- The design is the proposed epic plan "Copy chips: click-to-copy text authored in Obsidian notes" (research: research:202611/obsidian_copy_chips/obsidian_copy_chips.md). Its adopt phase converts any Summarize yesterday prompt that landed quoted, and appends a correcting note here if the shipped syntax changes.

Lander: before closing the epic, confirm that the open Summarize yesterday row in gtd_daily.md carries this chip. If it does not, fix it.

COPY CHIP: when you add the Summarize yesterday row to gtd_daily.md, write its agent prompt as a copy chip, not a double-quoted string. The exact Markdown and rules are in the COPY CHIP note on the epic bead bob-cli-nh (read it with sase bead read bob-cli-nh). Keep existing copy chips intact when rewording the other review rows.
